description_short: For Y2O3 only, compare average GPC between plasma-enhanced ALD (PE-ALD) and thermal ALD within the 200–300 °C window, returning mode, average GPC, number of records, and an example co-reactant.

paper.title: Atomic and Molecular Layer Deposition of Functional Thin Films Based on Rare Earth Elements

postprocessing_notes.material_filter: Material labels are normalized by lowercasing, stripping markup such as [sub], and keeping only alphanumeric characters; entries are retained if the normalized form contains 'y2o3', 'yttria', or 'yttriumoxide'.
postprocessing_notes.gpc_normalization: GPC text is cleaned for punctuation and ranges; the first and last numeric values are extracted and averaged if they differ, yielding a single numeric GPC entry per row.
postprocessing_notes.temperature_window: Temperature strings are parsed to obtain minimum and maximum values; rows are kept if their range overlaps 200–300 °C (tmax ≥ 200 and tmin ≤ 300).
postprocessing_notes.mode_classification: Mode is classified as 'PE-ALD' if any co-reactant slot (P180043, P180044, P180045) contains the substring 'plasma' in its label or literal; otherwise, the mode is 'Thermal ALD'.
postprocessing_notes.aggregation: Results are grouped by mode; for each mode the query computes AVG(GPC), COUNT(*), and a SAMPLE co-reactant string as an example.
